phases.title: Runtime Frame Dispatch Ownership
acceptance: the runtime-owned dispatcher has explicit paused, open, closing, sealed, and dispatched states with one named linearization authority and deterministic internal close transition
submission, duplicate/retry, late-ingress, transport backpressure, replacement pause, shutdown, and epoch-exhaustion outcomes are typed before planning
the same already-admitted ingress set replays to the same ordered sealed frame, epoch/sequence assignment, and dispatcher counters through the dispatcher support seam

the phase exposes only a move-only sealed-frame handoff; production source gateways, concrete framework-loop ownership, and downstream consumption remain explicit Phase 4/5 work rather than fabricated Phase 3 callers
phases.instructions: Implement 3.8 Phase 3. Establish the runtime-owned dispatcher state machine and bounded transport lifecycle before source gateways, concrete framework-loop scheduling, or stream policy cause allocation work. Do not create proxy production callers or self-consuming handoffs for later phases.
phases.qa_focus: No mutable sealed frame, duplicate dispatch, unrelated frame epoch authority, raw public constructor, proxy framework loop, or self-acknowledged downstream handoff. Do not fail this phase merely because its Phase 4/5 production integrations are not yet present.

phases.title: Source-To-Frame Admission Gateways
acceptance: host measurement, Query projection, interaction, and durable resize submit only already admitted source truth through narrow runtime gateways, and a concrete non-test framework-turn owner exclusively drives close/pump
gateways preserve source generation and ordering posture but cannot select policy, invalidation, reuse, or commit

raw collector mutation, policy resolution, downstream acknowledgment, and receipt commit remain unreachable from adapters, callbacks, and fixtures; partial Query settlement enters only as typed source fact for later policy resolution
phases.instructions: Implement 3.8 Phase 4. Connect admitted source lanes and the concrete framework turn to the dispatcher through capability-shaped gateways with sealed entry identity/order. The framework owner may hand a sealed frame forward but cannot classify policy or self-acknowledge consumption.
phases.qa_focus: No raw host geometry ingress, Query payload cache, caller-owned frame id, callback-owned close/pump, adapter that can classify or commit, self-acknowledged handoff, or semantic family capacity policy in transport admission.

phases.title: Stream Classification And Typed Invalidation Plan
acceptance: sealed entries classify through distinct closed source-lane, stream-family, and invalidation-family types with frozen identity, ordering, duplicate, and gap law

the mandatory Phase 4 sealed-frame consumer accepts and acknowledges each exact move-only handoff only after policy acceptance, and total policy composition with exact numeric budgets resolves it into one immutable resolved frame plan containing typed invalidation artifacts and cadence/evidence verdict
this phase does not select neighborhoods, plan allocation, or commit receipts; same-frame pressure cannot bypass later locality proof
phases.instructions: Implement 3.8 Phase 5. Install the mandatory consumer of the Phase 4 sealed-frame handoff, then lower each accepted frame through explicit ordering, numeric budgets, policy composition, typed invalidation artifacts, and exact acknowledgment rather than generic debounce behavior.
phases.qa_focus: No pull-only policy helper, partial merge table, count-only ingress identity, raw-ingress evidence explosion, self-issued acknowledgment, or premature receipt commitment.

phases.title: Invalidation Family Closure And Graph Narrowing
acceptance: the resolved frame plan maps through closed invalidation families and admitted graph/Query narrowing before incremental replan lands
Query-backed layout facts enter only through admitted projection-consumption settlement and mapping law
host observations can target existing runtime neighborhoods and receipts but cannot mint new semantic dependency lanes
phases.instructions: Implement 3.8 Phase 6. Close invalidation family narrowing as a first-class runtime boundary that consumes graph and Query truth rather than re-deriving dependency meaning locally.
phases.qa_focus: No generic something-changed bucket, no host-owned dependency edges, and no local Query payload cache becoming allocation authority.

phases.title: Affected-Neighborhood Replan Selection
acceptance: replan work is expressed as an ordered transaction set over admitted neighborhoods with deterministic ordering and widen reasons
root primary, counted root widen, and forbidden root fallback are mechanically distinct
locality proof consumes authority-graph indexes, touched-graph consequences, and admitted replacement impact rather than recursive scans
complete selected neighborhood sets preflight and publish receipt/report/transaction/counter/evidence effects atomically, with idempotent replay and deterministic overlap handling
phases.instructions: Implement 3.8 Phase 7. Turn locality into a transaction-shaped proof artifact and the first ordinary atomic allocation transition so later resize, scroll, and portal churn cannot collapse into hidden broad replans.
phases.qa_focus: No root fallback disguised as shell work, no helper-owned dependency maps, no set-order folklore, and no partial multi-neighborhood publication.

phases.title: Continuous Viewport Resize Semantics
phases.owner: worth-ui viewport invalidation and cadence authority
acceptance: viewport extent observations classify through a distinct invalidation family and policy lane
viewport churn stays neighborhood-bounded with explicit receipt-count ceilings per policy
viewport observations cannot author durable semantic-state mutation or graph ownership
phases.instructions: Implement 3.8 Phase 8. Close viewport resize as host extent observation plus derived invalidation and commit policy, not as a hidden sibling of drag-driven resize state.
phases.qa_focus: No splitter-policy inheritance, no silent root collapse under shell churn, and no host observation becoming durable runtime meaning.

phases.title: Drag Preview And Durable Resize Commit
phases.owner: worth-ui drag preview and durable resize authority
acceptance: preview candidate paint and durable resize mutation are distinct lanes with separate cadences and explicit policy law
pointer-rate preview does not mutate committed receipt truth or durable semantic state unless admitted policy says so
durable resize mutation counts and committed receipt counts are bounded and inspectable
phases.instructions: Implement 3.8 Phase 9. Close drag preview and durable resize as separate runtime acts so continuous interaction never becomes implicit layout authority.
phases.qa_focus: No preview-through-report mutation, no gesture-local durable-state writes, and no hidden side effects during preview rendering.

phases.title: Scroll-Owned Allocation Semantics
acceptance: scroll-owned extent changes invalidate allocation through runtime-owned family semantics while pure offset remains projected interaction only
unsupported or contradictory scroll ownership denies with typed evidence rather than host fallback
3.8 does not smuggle virtualization or offset-sensitive allocation into ordinary scroll semantics
phases.instructions: Implement 3.8 Phase 10. Keep scroll ownership narrow, explicit, and runtime-owned, and freeze the non-virtualized default rather than leaving offset semantics mushy.
phases.qa_focus: No host-owned scroll dependency lane, no hidden virtualization assumptions, and no offset-triggered invalidation unless explicitly admitted.

phases.title: Portal-Anchored Allocation Semantics
acceptance: portal anchor identity, coordinate-space posture, and invalidation rules are explicit and typed
equivalent anchor rect movement preserves or replaces identity only according to the frozen portal identity rule
portal anchor churn widens only through graph-owned locality proof and typed transaction evidence
phases.instructions: Implement 3.8 Phase 11. Close portal anchoring as an allocation lane with explicit identity and locality law rather than floating host glue.
phases.qa_focus: No host-owned portal membership graph, no phantom anchor identity rule, and no layer-spanning bypass of neighborhood proof.

phases.title: Allocation Inspection Surface
acceptance: ordinary inspection can explain receipt existence, invalidation family, locality choice, reuse or denial, and geometry evidence without causal escalation
allocation inspection returns exact evidence refs and geometry-floor schema required by the spec
AI critique-readiness consumes receipt-backed geometry truth rather than screenshots or logs as primary authority
phases.instructions: Implement 3.8 Phase 12. Extend the shared inspection substrate so allocation truth is inspectable and critique-ready without minting a second debugger runtime.
phases.qa_focus: No logs-as-evidence, no causal-inspection dependency for local why, and no screenshot archaeology replacing receipt-backed geometry.

phases.title: Allocation Freshness And Lag Posture
acceptance: freshness and lag postures live on append-only receipt-report lineage rather than silent mutation of committed truth
posture transitions are explicit, typed, and consumer-legality constrained
host paint and later execution consumers obey different admitted freshness-consumption rules where the appendix says so
phases.instructions: Implement 3.8 Phase 13. Close freshness as a real state-transition contract over report lineage instead of a bag of adjectives attached after the fact.
phases.qa_focus: No committed-equals-current folklore, no denied-without-artifact home, and no preview sneaking back in as a committed-report posture.

phases.title: Allocation Counters And Denial Taxonomy
phases.owner: worth-ui allocation boundedness and denial authority
acceptance: counter names, denial families, and evidence cadence are explicit runtime surfaces rather than test-only commentary
mandatory denial families and widen reasons are closed and inspectable
boundedness proof can assert concrete maxima for receipt count, durable mutation count, neighborhood-set cardinality, and root-widen behavior
phases.instructions: Implement 3.8 Phase 14. Freeze the counters and denial vocabulary as production authority so performance and failure shape stay mechanically auditable.
phases.qa_focus: No generic fallback denials, no counter logic hiding only in certification, and no unbounded evidence churn at ingress rate.

phases.title: Runtime Integration And Certification Closeout
acceptance: the full hostile scenario runs through admitted graph, Query, measurement, invalidation, transaction, receipt, inspection, and certification lanes without bypass
deterministic replay, anti-bypass fences, and concrete oracle ceilings are proven on the real ordinary lane
3.9 can consume committed allocation truth without reopening preview semantics, receipt granularity, locality proof, freshness law, or denial vocabulary
phases.instructions: Implement 3.8 Phase 15. Close the milestone by proving the hostile ordinary lane, not by leaning on test-only shortcuts or certification-owned semantics.
phases.qa_focus: No production behavior hiding behind fixture seams, no remaining parallel dependency graph, and no closeout that still leaves 3.9 to answer 3.8's law questions.
